page: Amazon Web Services r7iz.12xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6455B processors running at a dedicated clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, but it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across memory and compute tasks. The instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core, image processing, and text processing tests. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 4250.25 GB/sec and large block uncached read speeds at 244.1 GB/sec. For database operations, the server demonstrates strong performance with 65.52 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a Passmark database score of 26029.38. It also supports advanced vector and matrix extensions, which assist in LLM inference tasks, processing 268.51 tokens per second for medium 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r7iz.12xlarge offers a high-density memory profile paired with high-frequency processing, making it a viable option for workloads requiring rapid memory access without the overhead of local storage. However, the lack of bundled local NVMe storage means all storage operations must rely on network-attached options, which may introduce latency tradeoffs. This server is best suited for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
